parameters.query:
WITH RECURSIVE chain AS (
  SELECT p.id AS prospect_id, s.id AS step_id, s.enabled, s.campaign_id, s.step_order, 0 AS depth
  FROM prospects p JOIN sequence_steps s ON s.id = p.current_step_id
  WHERE p.halted = false
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.prospect_id, ns.id, ns.enabled, ns.campaign_id, ns.step_order, c.depth + 1
  FROM chain c
  JOIN sequence_steps ns ON ns.campaign_id = c.campaign_id AND ns.step_order = c.step_order + 1
  WHERE c.enabled = false AND c.depth < 10
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (prospect_id) prospect_id, step_id, enabled
  FROM chain
  ORDER BY prospect_id, step_order DESC
)
UPDATE prospects p
SET current_step_id = CASE WHEN r.enabled THEN r.step_id ELSE NULL END,
    status = CASE WHEN NOT r.enabled THEN 'completed' ELSE p.status END
FROM resolved r
WHERE p.id = r.prospect_id AND r.step_id IS DISTINCT FROM p.current_step_id

SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM events e JOIN sequence_steps s ON s.id = e.step_id WHERE s.action_type = 'li_connect' AND e.event_type = 'sent' AND e.occurred_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS li_connect_today,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM events e JOIN sequence_steps s ON s.id = e.step_id WHERE s.action_type = 'li_visit' AND e.event_type = 'sent' AND e.occurred_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS li_visit_today,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM events e JOIN sequence_steps s ON s.id = e.step_id WHERE s.action_type IN ('email', 'email_followup') AND e.event_type = 'sent' AND e.occurred_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS email_today

SELECT
  p.id AS prospect_id,
  s.id AS step_id,
  s.campaign_id,
  s.step_order,
  s.action_type,
  s.trigger_type,
  s.event_condition,
  s.subject,
  s.body_template,
  p.full_name,
  p.company,
  p.email,
  p.linkedin_url,
  (SELECT ns.id FROM sequence_steps ns WHERE ns.campaign_id = s.campaign_id AND ns.step_order > s.step_order AND ns.enabled = true ORDER BY ns.step_order LIMIT 1) AS next_step_id
FROM prospects p
JOIN sequence_steps s ON s.id = p.current_step_id
WHERE p.halted = false
  AND (
    (s.trigger_type = 'time' AND COALESCE((SELECT MAX(occurred_at) FROM events e WHERE e.prospect_id = p.id), p.created_at) + s.delay_interval <= now())
    OR
    (s.trigger_type = 'event' AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM events e WHERE e.prospect_id = p.id AND e.event_type = (CASE s.event_condition WHEN 'on_accept' THEN 'accepted' WHEN 'on_reply' THEN 'replied' WHEN 'on_open' THEN 'opened' END)
    ))
  )
